description:
Endpoint for cloning an existing field association scheme into a new one.

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** *Administer Jira* [global permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/x4dKLg).

parameters.description: The ID of the source field association scheme to clone from
parameters.name: id

requestBody.description: The request containing the name and description for the new scheme

200.description: Returned if the clone was successful.

400.description: Returned if the request is invalid. If request is malformed, returns a collection of errors.

401.description: Returned if the authentication credentials are incorrect or missing.

403.description: Returned if the user does not have the required permissions

404.description: Returned if the feature flag is disabled or the source scheme ID is not found.
